illustration.description: Full-page woodcut portrait of St. John the Evangelist (ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ) framed within an ornate oval border decorated with intricate Ethiopian interlace (harag) motifs at the four corners and four cardinal points. Inside the oval, St. John is seated writing in an open codex, accompanied by his evangelist symbol, the Eagle, on the lower right. Above the eagle in the clouds are two haloed figures (a vision of the Father and the Son carrying the Cross), and at the top center is the Holy Spirit in the form of a dove above an open book and a ribbon inscribed 'ቅዱስ ዮሐንስ ።'.
